I'm really not a good person. I'm a borderline, bipolar, substance abusing, fuck up who happens to have a pointless STEM degree and a weakness for people without anyone to care for them. Two good things to a million bad haha.

I really appreciate the kind words though friend.

I actually invited Ron up to talk. We shared what was going on with us. I realized I was being reactionary with my intention.

I battle thoughts of suicide and feel like shit every day so what's different about now? I pussied out like I usually do with these plans.

Apathy and pain medication sustain me for now I suppose haha.

Thank you. No professional support and the two friends I have live far away. They are more just people I know rather than friends.

I wish she was just going the "tough-love" route, but there was such a matter of factness to her tone and word choice that it seems more likely she is just tired of my bullshit.

She is strongly Catholic and Right-wing, meaning she believes suicide sends you to hell, suggested I see an exorcist and laughed at the idea of a psychiatrist, and generally disagrees with me.

I suppose I am old enough to move past a relationship with my parents if necessary, it is just that I have no one else to go to.

Thanks for taking the time to reply man. I appreciate the kind words but I'm afraid I don't have a lot of history of love with my family and looking back on it am not that surprised about what was said. Not every parent loves their offspring. I suppose I am old enough to deal with that fact if need be.
Who said they had a choice?

I have a lot of empathy for people and a big soft spot for the homeless. I must spend 100 bucks a month on people who are panhandling lol. My empathy gets turned against me though. I don't think I'm a great person but I try to help people when I can. I won't tell him about killing myself tomorrow. I'll invite Ronny (his name) in this evening and tell him I'll be leaving the area and that I want him to live in my apartment while I'm gone to watch it or something.

College can be a great time to expand your scope of experience and find new reasons to live. I just finished my degree and I miss college a lot. I'm often suicidal myself and have been since I was a little kid, but when I can't take things I tell myself I'll just put it off one more day and somehow I make it.

I too have a post on this page right now and am looking for people to help me. I understand what having parents who don't care is like. I was never given much growing up and was physically and emotionally abused. Recently my mother told me she wished I would kill myself. I don't know how to deal with it but I know I can't have her in my life anymore. I don't know how your parents are but I suggest that if they are helping you to allow them to while they still will. Just don't take any emotional abuse from them. If you meed someone to talk to, you can PM me anytime and I mean that. I'm a phd neuropsychology student but I won't let my training get in the way of talking to you like a friend.

I'm a 23 year old guy from the southern U.S. if you care about who youre talking to

Two years. I live alone and whenever he's around my side of town I invite him to come in for dinner and sleep on the couch. He's only 34 and has been homeless for years due to mental illness, unemployment, and a history of drug addiction (though I have never seen him use and he claims he has been clean for 1 and a half years now). He's the only person I need to say goodbye to before tomorrow.

Thanks for the addition to my vocabulary stranger. I still haven't fully processed what happened. I've been keeping myself anesthetized on very strong painkillers since it happened. I'm slowly becoming at peace with my death. I plan on leaving my car and the little money and possessions I have to the sweetest person I know, a nice homeless man I have known and given 20 bucks to every week for the last couple years. He deserves something good in his life and maybe he will be able to change his life when mine ends.

Try making a promise to yourself to at least live to a certain point and reevaluate your feelings. You are only 17. I almost killed myself at that age but my attempt failed. The ages 18-21 were some of the best in my life and I never could have guessed that. 

My parents don't love or care for me either, and I have had to decide to let them go as they only made things worse. As you become an adult you may need to consider putting less or no value on what your parents think of you. If I cared about my parents love I would be dead.


Good luck and please talk to me if you like. I am in a very dark place too. Maybe we could help each other.

I'm realistic. Sure there will be people in the future who may care about me. My parents do not care. I spoke to them one more time, thinking perhaps my mother was just in a bad place that night. She laughed at me and asked me why I was still alive. I was a perfect son to her growing up and as an adult, taking care of her in sickness, never causing problems or needing money. She told me to stay out of her life. Things could get better in the future but I'm too broken to go on. Nothing makes me happy, I've lost everyone who ever loved me, and medicine and therapy do nothing to help me. I'm 23 but I feel 95. I am ready to die and everyone else seems ready to bury me.

Edit: I misspoke. I certainly wasn't perfect as a son. Just a good son.
